summary: Phase 14 — ARISE persistence + NEXUS (Campus ERP) + COMPASS (NAAC AQAR) + PATHFINDER (Placements) + COMMAND (Executive Centre). Backend: 13/14 pytest cases PASS (one expectation-vs-implementation mismatch on PATHFINDER resume-score band — see backend_issues.minor). Frontend: all 4 new pages render with required testids, sidebar shows Campus Operations group + 4 new entries, COMPASS freeze produces toast 'AQAR aqar-* frozen · projected grade A', NEXUS attendance data visible end-to-end (2 sessions / 50% pct), cross-tenant security enforced on all 5 routers.

minor.issue: Brief inputs (skills=[python,aws,system design,docker], projects=3, internships=1, cgpa=8.7) yield total=69, band='Good'. Brief expected total>=70 and band='Strong'. Math: skill_kw=8+8+9+6=31 (capped 40) + completeness (projects≥2→10, internships≥1→12)=22 + cgpa(8.7→16) = 69. To meet the brief either (a) lower Strong threshold from 75→65, or (b) add a +1 in cgpa table for 8.5-8.9, or (c) widen the completeness table so 3 projects awards an extra few pts. Currently band 'Strong' requires total>=75 which this profile cannot reach without certifications/leadership/publications.

action_items: PATHFINDER resume-score: align scoring formula with Phase-1 brief expectation. Either drop Strong threshold from 75 to 65 in routes_pathfinder.py:_resume_score, or boost CGPA weighting (e.g. 8.5-8.9 → 18 instead of 16). Without one of these, the documented sample profile (4 skills + 3 projects + 1 internship + CGPA 8.7) cannot hit 'Strong'.

(Nit) COMPASS history list uses a single 'compass-history-list' container testid (no per-row testid). For automated regression on history-row count, consider adding 'compass-hist-row-{id}' on each snapshot card.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admissions.py / routes_nexus.py / routes_compass.py / routes_pathfinder.py / routes_command.py — all 5 routers consistently apply _guard(user, institution_id) on every endpoint and exclude {_id: 0} from Mongo reads. Clean.

routes_nexus.py:verify is correctly public (no Depends(get_current_user)) — matches the brief's recruiter-verification use case. Returns minimal info (student_name, cert_type, issued_at, verify_code) so it is safe to expose.

routes_compass.py:freeze_aqar reuses preview_aqar(institution_id, user) — neat DRY. Side note: it relies on the await on a coroutine — works only because preview is itself an async route handler invoked directly. Acceptable inside FastAPI.

routes_compass.py:preview_aqar awaits db.list_collection_names() on every preview call (line 46) — for tenants with many collections this is an O(n) chatty call to Mongo. Replace with try/except or hoist into a startup cache.
routes_pathfinder.py:apply_drive correctly returns 400 for branch ineligibility, 409 for duplicate apply, 404 for missing drive — distinct status codes are good.

routes_command.py:forecast synthesizes history from a single 'learners' metric with hard-coded deltas [-0.18..0.0]. For Phase-2 wire to a real enrolment_cycles collection; current implementation always produces 'growth' trend on positive-base tenants which makes the brief-required check trivially pass.

routes_command.py:readiness — outreach formula `min(alumni_network/500, 100)` produces 60% at 30000 alumni which is correct numerically; consider exposing the formula in /readiness response for transparency.
routes_pathfinder.py:_resume_score band threshold (Strong>=75) is tighter than the Phase-1 brief implies. See backend_issues.minor.

rca of the issue: PATHFINDER resume-score band='Good' when brief expects 'Strong': root cause is the additive scoring scheme in routes_pathfinder.py:_resume_score where skill_keywords (cap 40) + completeness (max 22 without certs/leadership/publications) + cgpa (max 20) cannot exceed 82 for the brief's sample input, and the Strong band requires >=75. With the sample's component scores (31+22+16=69) the total falls into 'Good' (>=55). Mitigation: either lower Strong threshold (75→65) OR raise the cgpa table for 8.5-8.9 from 16 to 18 OR award an extra +5 in completeness when projects>=3.
